name: New comments on your documents
title: New comments on your documents: comments left in the last days on the Google documents your tasks link to, not yet answered, in the morning brief

events.opened: You pressed Open the comment on a new comment the morning brief listed
events.task: You pressed Open the task on a new comment the morning brief listed
events.let_be: You pressed Let it be on a new comment the morning brief listed

runs.shown: Rouh put new comments on your tasks' documents in the morning brief

permissions: reads the Google document links in every task's notes
reads the comments on those documents in Rouh's own Google Drive
keeps the comments you let be in your own settings
touches.remove: Turn the switch new_comments off on its row in Evolution, Mutations, and the section is gone; to remove it for good revert night 26's commit (rouh/new_comments.py, the brief_new_comments route and its lines in rouh/web/brief.py and rouh/project/urls.py, drawNewComments and its helpers in briefpage.js, the .bf-newcomment rules in briefpage.css, this manifest; rouh/comments_in_docs.py goes with the last of the three genes that use it) and delete the user setting new_comments.
